notes: Stops: all 17 stations from OpenStreetMap subway nodes (station=subway), ordered Uttara North -> Motijheel + Kamalapur; ordered list cross-checked on Wikipedia and dhakametrorail.org. End-to-end run ~38 min matches real-world timing; intermediate stop_times are even-spaced (~2.5 min/hop) estimates, NOT published per-station timetables (DMTCL publishes headways, not a full stop-level timetable). Representative trips: 2 per direction weekday (first + midday) and 1 per direction Friday, since only headway is published. route_type=1 (metro/subway, elevated rapid transit). Coordinates are OSM station-node lat/lon. Two service calendars: weekday(Sat-Thu) and Friday(PM only). Confidence 0.62: station list/order/coords are solid; per-station clock times are modeled from headway+terminal times rather than an official stop-level timetable.
